backend/main.mo: Main Motoko actor for a cloud storage backend that composes authorization and blob-storage mixins, and defines types and state for files, folders, notifications, activity logs, trash, sharing, favorites, and user quotas.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping implemented features (bulk action buttons, Download All, Favorites All, Shared All, Move All, Delete All) to their source files, components, and test IDs with confidence ratings.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: JSON document containing one-to-two sentence summaries of each frontend source file, serving as a reference index for the project's React components, pages, and hooks.
frontend/index.css: Global Tailwind CSS entry point that defines CSS custom properties for the design system's color tokens in both light and dark themes, including sidebar, chart, and semantic UI variables.
frontend/index.html: Minimal HTML shell for the React SPA that mounts the app into a root div and loads the main TypeScript entry point as an ES module.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root application component that sets up TanStack Router with all page routes, handles Internet Identity authentication flow, enforces a 15-second actor connection timeout with a retry mechanism, and gates rendering behind profile setup for new users.
frontend/src/components/ActivityFeed.tsx: Card component that displays a scrollable list of recent file activities (upload, download, delete) with icons and relative timestamps, fetched via useGetRecentActivities, with loading and empty states.
frontend/src/components/BulkDeleteDialog: Alert dialog for bulk-deleting multiple files, allowing users to select a retention period (30/60/90 days) before moving files to trash.
Dialog for sharing multiple selected files with another user by entering their principal ID and configuring view/edit/download permissions.
Full-screen error UI displayed when the app fails to connect to the backend, offering retry and page-refresh actions.
frontend/src/components/CreateFolderDial: Dialog for creating a new folder (or subfolder) by entering a name, using the useCreateFolder mutation with loading and error feedback.
frontend/src/components/DeleteConfirmati: Alert dialog for permanently deleting selected trash items, showing file count and total size with an optional secure-wipe checkbox.
frontend/src/components/DeleteFileDialog: Dialog for moving a single file to trash, letting the user choose a retention period (default 30 days, up to 90 days) before confirming.
frontend/src/components/DeleteFolderConf: Alert dialog for permanently deleting one or more trashed folders, warning that all contained files and subfolders will also be irreversibly removed.
frontend/src/components/DeleteFolderDial: A confirmation dialog for moving a folder to trash, using the `useDeleteFolderToTrash` mutation and showing a loading state during deletion.
frontend/src/components/DeleteFolderToTr: A dialog for moving a folder to trash with a configurable retention period (30/60/90 days), converting the selection to nanoseconds before calling the provided `onConfirm` callback.
frontend/src/components/ErrorBoundary.ts: A React class-based error boundary that catches runtime errors and displays an alert with retry/refresh options, showing error details in development mode.
frontend/src/components/FileFilterDropdo: A dropdown UI component for filtering files by name, type, date range, and size range, with an active filter count badge and a clear-all option.
frontend/src/components/FileList.tsx: The main file and folder listing component supporting selection, search, filtering, sorting, pagination, previews, and context-menu actions like delete, move, rename, and protection management.
frontend/src/components/FilePreview.tsx: A full-screen file preview overlay that renders images, videos, PDFs, and text files from raw byte data, with a download button and close control.
A debounced search input component with a clear button, used for filtering files by name or type.
frontend/src/components/FileSortDropdown: A dropdown menu component that allows users to sort files by name, date, size, or type, displaying the current sort field and direction with icons.
frontend/src/components/FileToolbar.tsx: A toolbar component combining search input, filter dropdown, sort dropdown, and grid/list view toggle controls for the file browser interface.
frontend/src/components/FileUpload.tsx: A drag-and-drop file upload component that supports multi-file selection, shows upload progress, and adds uploaded files to a recent uploads context.
frontend/src/components/FolderBreadcrumb: A recursive breadcrumb navigation component that walks up the folder parent chain to render clickable path segments for folder navigation.
frontend/src/components/FolderPasswordPr: A dialog component that prompts users to enter a password to unlock a protected folder, enforcing a 5-attempt lockout and triggering a security notification on lockout.
frontend/src/components/FolderProtection: A modal for managing folder password protection and lock state, supporting setting, changing, and removing passwords with SHA-256 hashing and current-password verification.
frontend/src/components/Header.tsx: The app's sticky header with navigation, theme toggle, unread notification badge, and a user avatar dropdown menu for profile and logout actions.
frontend/src/components/Layout.tsx: The root layout component that renders the Header, Sidebar, and a main content area with an Outlet wrapped in an ErrorBoundary.
frontend/src/components/LoadingTimeout.t: A wrapper component that shows a 'Taking too long' error UI with a refresh button if the loading state exceeds a configurable timeout (default 45 seconds).
frontend/src/components/MoveFolderDialog: A dialog for moving a folder to a new parent destination, filtering out the folder's own descendants from valid targets and showing a confirmation step before executing the move.
frontend/src/components/MoveToFolderDial: A dialog that allows users to select a destination folder via radio buttons and move one or more files into it using the moveFilesToFolder mutation.
frontend/src/components/Notifications.ts: Displays a list of user notifications (storage warnings, shares, activity alerts, system announcements) with icons, formatted timestamps, and mark-as-read functionality.
frontend/src/components/PaginationContro: A reusable pagination UI component supporting page navigation, ellipsis for large page counts, items-per-page selection, and display of the current item range.
frontend/src/components/PinnedFiles.tsx: Displays the user's favorited/pinned files as a horizontal scrollable card list, showing file name and size, with loading skeletons and empty/error states.
frontend/src/components/ProfileSetup.tsx: An onboarding form that collects a display name and optional email to create the user's profile, then calls saveCallerUserProfile and invokes a callback on success.
frontend/src/components/QuickActions.tsx: Renders three quick-action buttons (Upload Files, New Folder, Create Text Document) that trigger file uploads, folder creation dialog, or blank text file creation, using mutation hooks and toast notifications.
frontend/src/components/RecentActivityCa: Displays a list of recent file activities (upload, delete, restore, share) fetched via a query hook, with loading skeletons, error state, and empty state handling.
frontend/src/components/RenameFileDialog: Modal dialog for renaming a file that currently shows an informative error toast because the backend rename endpoint is not yet implemented.
frontend/src/components/RenameFolderDial: Modal dialog that allows users to rename a folder by calling the useRenameFolder mutation hook, with validation and toast feedback.
frontend/src/components/RestoreDialog.ts: Modal dialog that lets users restore selected trash items to either their original location or a custom folder path, with a radio group and optional path input.
frontend/src/components/SharedByMe.tsx: Displays a paginated, searchable list of file shares sent by the current user, supporting individual and bulk share revocation with selection checkboxes.
frontend/src/components/SharedWithMe.tsx: Displays files shared with the current user, supporting search, pagination, bulk download, preview, and per-file permission checks.
frontend/src/components/Sidebar.tsx: Renders the app's collapsible left navigation sidebar with route links, an admin link for admin users, and a storage quota indicator at the bottom.
frontend/src/components/SmartSuggestions: Shows a list of AI-driven file suggestions based on access history, with loading skeletons and empty/error states.
Displays a storage usage card with a color-coded progress bar and used/total byte labels fetched from the storage quota query.
frontend/src/components/StorageQuotaIndi: Compact sidebar widget showing storage usage as a small progress bar and used/total text, using the storage quota query.
frontend/src/components/TrashFilters.tsx: Provides filter controls (search, file type, owner, date range, original path) for the trash view, emitting filtered TrashMetadata arrays on change.
frontend/src/components/TrashStorageIndi: Card component that shows how much storage the trash is consuming and its percentage of the user's total quota.
frontend/src/components/UserStorageManag: Admin table listing all users' storage usage and quotas, with a dialog to edit individual user quotas in MB.
frontend/src/contexts/RecentUploadsConte: Provides a React context for tracking recently uploaded files, exposing methods to add and clear upload records with timestamp, fileId, name, size, and owner.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Custom hook that creates and caches an authenticated or anonymous ICP backend actor using React Query, invalidating dependent queries whenever the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useFileFilters.ts: Custom hook managing file filter state (name, type, date range, size range) and providing a memoized function to apply those filters to a list of FileMetadata.
frontend/src/hooks/useFileSearch.ts: Custom hook that maintains a search query string and provides a memoized function to filter FileMetadata by file name or extension.
frontend/src/hooks/useFileSorting.ts: Custom hook managing sort state (field and order) and providing a memoized function to sort FileMetadata by name, date, size, or type.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Implements Internet Identity authentication via AuthClient, exposing login/logout, identity state, and login status through a React context provider and hook.
frontend/src/hooks/usePagination.ts: Generic pagination hook that tracks current page and items-per-page state, and provides a function to slice any data array to the current page's items.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Centralizes all React Query hooks for the backend actor, covering file listing, chunked uploads, folder operations, trash, sharing, favorites, notifications, and more.
frontend/src/index.css: Global stylesheet that imports Tailwind directives and defines CSS custom properties for light and dark theme color tokens.
frontend/src/lib/utils.ts: Exports a single `cn` utility that merges Tailwind class names using clsx and tailwind-merge.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that mounts the React app wrapped in QueryClientProvider and InternetIdentityProvider.
frontend/src/pages/AdminDashboard.tsx: Admin dashboard page that checks caller admin status and renders summary stat cards alongside UserStorageManager and ActivityFeed components, showing an access-denied card for non-admins.
frontend/src/pages/Dashboard.tsx: Main file manager page with folder navigation breadcrumbs, collapsible upload area, a file list, and a create-folder dialog.
frontend/src/pages/Home.tsx: Home/overview page displaying storage overview, quick-action links, pinned files, recent activity, notifications, and smart suggestions in a responsive grid layout.
frontend/src/pages/LoginPage.tsx: Login page that presents feature highlights and a single Internet Identity sign-in button using the useInternetIdentity hook.
frontend/src/pages/Recent.tsx: Recent uploads page that displays files from RecentUploadsContext with search, filter, sort, pagination, bulk selection, preview, and delete functionality.
frontend/src/pages/Settings.tsx: Settings page allowing users to view account info, configure trash retention period, and switch the app theme via next-themes.
frontend/src/pages/Shared.tsx: Shared files page with two tabs — 'Shared With Me' and 'Shared By Me' — rendering the corresponding SharedWithMe and SharedByMe components.
frontend/src/pages/Trash.tsx: React page component for the Trash view that displays deleted files and folders in tabbed tables with sorting, filtering, pagination, and bulk/individual restore and permanent-delete actions via mutation hooks.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility module providing helper functions to read URL query parameters (supporting both standard and hash-based routing), persist them to sessionStorage, and clean sensitive params from the URL hash without a page reload.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration that sets up dark mode, custom OKLCH-based design tokens (colors, border radius, animations), and registers the typography, container-queries, and animate plugins.
project_state.json: Project state manifest (schema v1) tracking implemented features, architectural notes, and known issues for a file manager app with bulk action bar enhancements, per-file menus, and folder protection.
